svg.title: Externally powered DC water-pump MOSFET driver
svg.desc: A Raspberry Pi or BeagleBone GPIO controls the gate of an N-channel logic-level MOSFET through a gate resistor and pull-down. A separate fused, current-limited supply powers the pump. A flyback diode is connected across the pump with its cathode toward positive, and the non-isolated driver uses one documented common reference.
